page.layout: One page of running text in one column, with two section headings (§. 3 and §. 4) across the full text width. No margin notes. Printed page number 91 at top right, running head ILLUSTRATUM. at top left. Gathering signature M 2 at the foot.

main_text.l: tempus excidii domus secundæ, quo gentes multo numero
visæ sunt legere Mosen & Prophetas, atque
omissis idolis profiteri Deum Abrahami, Isaaci, & Jacobi,
eundemque precibus colere, atque cultu rationali
venerari:
§. 3. Alloquium, ad quos directum?
ALloquium concipio ut directum ad cœtum gentium
vocatarum: loquitur enim de Judæis rebellibus,
& contumaciæ convictis in tertiâ personâ, ut & de filiis &
filiabus rupis, id est de credentibus ex Judæis.
Unde sequitur hanc promulgationem sententiæ Divinæ
notificari inter gentes, atque ita alloquium præconis
dirigi ad tertium genus hominum extra Judæorum con-
sortium constitutorum, ut sunt gentes, aut ex gentibus
credentes: nam verbum Dei promulgatum per hunc
præconem, si Judæos æque credentes ac incredulos ex-
cipias, auditores inter homines habere non potuit, nisi
gentes in populum adscitas, aut adscisendas saltem.
§. 4. Scopus & ratio hujus promulgationis.
RAtio promulgandæ hujus sententiæ divinæ inter
gentes, & quidem ante exsecutionis ejus diem,
nulla alia est, quam defensio causæ Christi, argumen-
to ex condemnatione hostium ejus desumpto: invitantur
enim gentes, ut severitatem Dei in Judæos ex supplicii
gravitate perpendant, atque exinde adscenderent
ad investigandam causam tantæ iræ. Describitur autem
pœna adversus Judæos decreta ut exemplaris, Judæos
infignis

page.notes: The large initial R of "RAtio" and A of "ALloquium" are decorative woodcut-style initials, joined to the following word as instructed. Show-through and edge fragments in the left margin are not printed text and are omitted. No reference marks or margin notes are printed on this page. The word "adscisendas" follows the long-s form as printed (appearing as "adscifcendas" on the scan); the rest of the page is clear.
